user.title: Add a managed switch
user.description: The switch is read over SNMP and never changed. SNMPv3 is recommended: it checks every request and encrypts the answers. [Help]({docs})

data_description.host: Address or name of the switch.
data_description.port: UDP port of the switch's SNMP agent, usually 161.
data_description.snmp_version: SNMPv1 and v2c send the community in clear text.

data_description.community: The read-only community as set on the switch.

usm.title: SNMPv3 user
usm.description: A read-only SNMPv3 user of {host}, with the protocols set for it on the switch. [Help]({docs})

data_description.auth_protocol: Some older switches offer only SHA (SHA-1) or MD5.
data_description.priv_protocol: Some older switches offer only DES.
data_description.user: The user name on the switch.
data_description.auth_key: Leave empty when the authentication protocol is "None".
data_description.priv_key: Leave empty when the privacy protocol is "None".

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: The next step asks for the credentials again. [Help]({docs})

data_description.host: Address or name of the switch.
data_description.port: UDP port of the switch's SNMP agent, usually 161.
data_description.snmp_version: SNMPv1 and v2c send the community in clear text.

error.timeout: The switch did not answer. Check the address, that SNMP is on, and the community (with a wrong community, switches stay silent).
error.invalid_auth: The switch rejected the SNMPv3 user, its passwords or protocols.
error.key_missing: Enter a password for each protocol that is not "none", and use privacy only with authentication.
error.no_identity: The switch reports no MAC address, so it cannot be told apart from others.
error.cannot_connect: The switch answered with an error.

abort.already_configured: This switch is set up already.
abort.wrong_switch: That is a different switch than the one set up.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often the switch is read. [Help]({docs})

data.slow_interval: Address table, LLDP, PoE and spanning tree

data_description.fast_interval: Seconds between two readings of the ports.
data_description.slow_interval: Seconds between two readings of the tables; switches forget silent devices after about five minutes.

state.uplink_down: Uplink or trunk lost its link

auth.message: The switch rejected the SNMPv3 credentials.

timeout.message: The switch did not answer in time.

resolve.message: The switch's address cannot be resolved.
